actions.command:
set -e
# Step 1: DURABLE FENCE of old primary. Preserve primary.failed; create primary.fenced.
[ -e /var/lib/failover/primary.failed ] && echo "primary.failed present (preserved)"
printf 'fenced by agent at %s: old primary 127.0.0.1:8081 remains failed\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" > /var/lib/failover/primary.fenced
# fsync the directory and file durably
sync /var/lib/failover/primary.fenced /var/lib/failover/primary.failed 2>/dev/null || sync
ls -la /var/lib/failover/
echo "--- confirm no 8081 listener ---"
ss -ltn 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':8081\b' || echo "8081 not listening (good)"

set -e

# Promote replica -> primary (atomic write)
printf 'primary\n' > replica.role.tmp && sync replica.role.tmp && mv -f replica.role.tmp replica.role
# Switch proxy upstream -> 8082 (atomic write)
printf '8082\n' > upstream.tmp && sync upstream.tmp && mv -f upstream.tmp upstream
sync
echo "replica.role = $(cat replica.role)"; echo "upstream = $(cat upstream)"
ls -la /var/lib/failover/
